card.name: Space or comma just before a number
card.fires_on: Mostly the space (or a comma inside a number) right before a numeric value, such as a rate, duration, dose range or study number. It also fires on a few small linking words in medical sentences.

modes.label: Gap before a number
modes.description: A space or thousands comma sits right before a quantity, duration or rate.

modes.description: A small connecting word like 'and', 'as' or 'including' in sentences about ARIA.
